Initial release of gws-modelarmor-sanitize-response.

- Adds command to sanitize model responses using a Model Armor template.
- Supports both text and full JSON input for sanitization.
- Includes CLI flags for specifying templates and content.
- Provides usage instructions, examples, and related resource links.
- Designed for outbound model safety; see +sanitize-prompt for inbound use.
